snippet.title: SAINT OF CHAINS - Gameplay Trailer (PS2-Style Psychological Horror)
snippet.description:
#indiehorror #psychologicalhorror #steamgame 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4079340/Saint_of_Chains/

SAINT OF CHAINS is a retro psychological horror game in first-person, blending PS2-era atmosphere with tense exploration and survival pressure.

Psychological single-player first-person horror. Explore dark environments, fight with melee and guns, and solve puzzles in this retro 2000s-inspired nightmare where the truth is more terrifying than the monsters.

• Retro-inspired visuals (PS2/early-3D horror vibes)
• Psychological horror + oppressive atmosphere
• Exploration-driven pacing with moments of sudden danger
• Scarce resources / limited shooting focus
• Designed for reaction-heavy playthroughs
•  For horror fans who love Silent Hill 3, Cry of Fear, Lost in Vivo and Condemned!

Steam Next Fest Demo: February 23, 2026
Full Release: May 12, 2026

Wishlist on Steam to support the game + get the demo/release updates:
